mapper.select: select id, type_name, type_code, template, description, is_active, create_time, update_time from notification_type where is_active = 1

SELECT u.id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_image, CASE n.object_type WHEN 3 THEN n.content WHEN 4 THEN '[图片]' WHEN 5 THEN '[文件]' WHEN 6 THEN '[视频]' WHEN 7 THEN '[语音]' ELSE n.content END as last_message, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as last_message_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE recipient_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = u.id AND is_read = 0 AND type = 1) as unread_count FROM user u JOIN user_info ui ON u.id = ui.user_id JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END as chat_user_id, sender_id, content, object_type, create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END ORDER BY create_time DESC) as rn FROM notification WHERE (recipient_id = #{userId} OR sender_id = #{userId}) AND type = 1 ) n ON n.chat_user_id = u.id AND n.rn = 1 ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

select n.id as id, ui.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_image, n.content as content, n.object_type as object_type, n.object_id as object_id, coalesce( p.title, s.content, (SELECT cc.content FROM comments cm JOIN comment_content cc ON cm.id = cc.comment_id WHERE cm.id = n.object_id) ) as object_title, n.create_time as create_time, n.is_read as is_read from notification n join user_info ui on n.sender_id = ui.user_id left join posts p on n.object_type = 0 and n.object_id = p.id left join share s on n.object_type = 1 and n.object_id = s.id left join comments c on n.object_type = 2 and n.object_id = c.id where n.type = 2 and recipient_id = #{userId} and sender_id != #{userId} order by n.create_time desc

select ui.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_image, n.create_time as create_time, n.content as content, n.is_read as is_read from notification n join user_info ui on n.sender_id = ui.user_id where type = 3 and recipient_id = #{userId} order by n.create_time desc

select ui.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_image, n.content as content, n.object_type as object_type, n.object_id as object_id, coalesce( p.title, s.content, (SELECT cc.content FROM comments cm JOIN comment_content cc ON cm.id = cc.comment_id WHERE cm.id = n.object_id) ) as object_title, n.create_time as create_time, n.is_read as is_read from notification n join user_info ui on n.sender_id = ui.user_id left join posts p on n.object_type = 0 and n.object_id = p.id left join share s on n.object_type = 1 and n.object_id = s.id left join comments c on n.object_type = 2 and n.object_id = c.id where (n.type = 4 or n.type = 5) and recipient_id = 1 order by case when n.update_time is not null then n.update_time else n.create_time end desc
select user_id, user_name, image as user_image from user_info where user_id = #{userId}

select id as message_id, sender_id, create_time as send_time, content, object_type as content_type from notification where type = 1 and ( (sender_id = #{po.userId} and recipient_id = #{po.targetUserId}) or (sender_id = #{po.targetUserId} and recipient_id = #{po.userId}) ) order by create_time

select ui.id as id, ui.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.sex as sex, ui.image as image, ui.introduction as introduction, ui.region as region, ui.birth_date as birth_date, ui.profession as profession, ui.is_vip as is_vip, ui.exp as exp, ui.create_time as create_time, ui.update_time as update_time from
posts
share
comments
t inner join user_info ui on
t.author_id = ui.user_id
t.user_id = ui.user_id
where t.id = #{targetId}
select id, user_id, user_name, sex, image, introduction, region, birth_date, profession, is_vip, exp, create_time, update_time from user_info where user_id = #{userId}
